subject: Secure access: IP allowlist, temporary portal link, and SOC 2 bridge letter
messages:
From: KP Audit <auditor@kp-audit.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>; security_pm@acme.com
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Portal access window + IPs for SOC2 Type II review

Hi Diego,

We're scheduling our read-through for ACME's integration and need temporary access to Redwood's trust portal for the SOC 2 Type II artifacts. Two quick asks so we can finalize the booking: 

- Can you provision a temporary download window for KP Audit next week (preferred: Mar 2 09:00-13:00 PT)?
- We need the IP addresses (or IP range) to add to our allowlist on the auditor side.

Also: ACME's security team (cc'd) asked whether Redwood can provide a short bridge letter clarifying whether the SOC 2 report covers the period Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026, and whether any control changes occurred after the report period that would materially affect the scope. A 1-paragraph bridge letter is fine.

Attachments: none on our side.

Thanks,
Jason Park
Senior Auditor, KP Audit
[jason.park@kp-audit.com]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: KP Audit <auditor@kp-audit.com>
Cc: security_pm@acme.com
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Portal access window + IPs for SOC2 Type II review

Jason — thanks for the note and the preferred window. We can absolutely support this; a few details so we set it up right: 

- Temporary access: We can create an ephemeral SSO link tied to your email that will be valid for the requested 4-hour window. We also offer a short-lived service account guest link if SSO isn't possible.
- IP allowlist: We can allowlist a set of CIDR ranges at the portal edge for the session (preferred) or provide a downloadable bundle with MFA enforced. If you can send the auditor source IPs (or the CIDR), we'll add them to the session rule.
- Bridge letter: happy to supply. We'll draft a one-paragraph bridge letter that confirms the SOC 2 Type II coverage period and notes whether any material controls changed after the period.
- Evidence scope: which artifact types do you need to download? (SOC report PDF, control matrices, penetration test summary, evidence bundles). Listing these will help us stage the folder.

For internal: Marissa / Neha — can you take the bridge letter draft and the temporary SSO instructions? I attached a short template we use for SSO instructions and the standard bridge-letter template. If possible, I'd like a 2-hour lead time before the session to provision and test access.

Attachments: [temporary_sso_instructions.txt (plain text, 6KB)]

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: KP Audit <auditor@kp-audit.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>; security_pm@acme.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Portal access window + IPs for SOC2 Type II review

Diego / Jason / team — thanks, Diego. Jason — looping Neha (Compliance) for the bridge letter draft and evidence packaging. 

A few specifics from our side: 
- Evidence bundle: we'll stage the SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), control matrix (CSV), and the most recent penetration test executive summary (PDF). If you need raw evidence files, specify the folders and we'll mark them for temporary download.
- IP allowlist recommendation: if you can provide either a single static IP or a /24, that works best. If auditors are coming from a rotating IP pool (e.g., remote auditors), we can instead require MFA and issue an ephemeral SSO link tied to a one-time passcode.
- Bridge letter: attached is our draft for review. It's intentionally short; please mark edits.

Attachments: [bridge_letter_draft.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

Next steps for Jason: confirm (1) preferred access method (ephemeral SSO vs allowlist), (2) exact IP(s) or CIDR if allowlisting, and (3) whether the April 2026 tech-change note needs to be spelled out in the bridge letter. Once we have that we can provision the session and email the SSO link + instructions.

—Marissa
Director, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: KP Audit <auditor@kp-audit.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_pm@acme.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Portal access window + IPs for SOC2 Type II review

Marissa / Diego — thanks for the fast turnaround and the draft.

We will use a fixed IP range for the engagement team: 34.215.128.0/24 (this will be the single source CIDR to add to the allowlist). Prefer to use the allowlist approach; auditors will authenticate with SSO + MFA.

Scope confirmation: please stage SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), control matrix (CSV), and the penetration test executive summary (PDF). We do not need the raw evidence blobs for this read — the staged bundle is fine.

Bridge letter: the April 2026 tech change note is relevant; please include a single sentence that the change was a planned upgrade to logging/alerting and that controls were validated post-change and remained in scope. The rest of the draft looks good.

Access window: can you provision the ephemeral session for Tue Mar 2, 09:00-13:00 PT as requested? Please confirm when allowlist is in place so we can run a quick test.

Thanks — Jason
KP Audit
[jason.park@kp-audit.com]
